description: This file defines the JSHandle class used in Playwright for managing JavaScript object handles within the browser context, including methods for evaluation, property access, serialization, and disposal.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a JavaScript object in the browser context, providing methods for evaluation, property access, and disposal.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSHandle instance from a channel handle.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the context of the handle.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property handle by name.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves all properties as a map of name to handle.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON value of the handle.

methods.name: asElement
methods.description: Returns the handle as an element handle if applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string preview of the handle.
